candidates.old:
LDA viewport_left_low
    SEC
    SBC movers_x_low,X
    LDA viewport_left_high          \ (the low byte only for its borrow: left_of_view redoes it)
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS left_of_view                \ viewport_left >= x
    STZ dm_jmin                     \ 65C02 opcode
.jmin_done
    LDA viewport_right_low
    SEC
    SBC movers_x_low,X
    STA dm_jmax
    LDA viewport_right_high
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS not_right_of_view
candidates.new:
LDA viewport_right_low          \ grind: R = viewport_right - x first. The viewport is always 79 columns
    SEC                             \ wide (right = left + 79: the start sets &00B0/&00FF and every scroll
    SBC movers_x_low,X              \ moves both), so the mover starts left of the view's edge with its
    TAY                             \ columns showing exactly when R is 0..78; Y = R's low byte
    LDA viewport_right_high
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCC g3_far                      \ R < 0: the mover starts right of the viewport
    BNE g3_big                      \ R >= &100
    CPY #79
    BCS g3_small                    \ R = 79..255: viewport_left >= x
    STZ dm_jmin                     \ 65C02 opcode: R = 0..78: jmin 0, jmax R
    STY dm_jmax
    BRA jmax_done                   \ 65C02 opcode
.g3_big
    LDY #&FF                        \ jmax 255
.g3_small
    STY dm_jmax                     \ (R's low byte, or 255)
    LDA viewport_left_low           \ left_of_view's entry: C set, Z = the high byte of left - x is 0
    SEC
    SBC movers_x_low,X
    LDA viewport_left_high
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BRA left_of_view                \ left >= x (R >= 79): C is set
.jmin_done
    BRA jmax_done                   \ left_of_view's return: dm_jmax is set
.g3_far
candidates.summary: R-first clip: compute right - x once (the viewport is always 79 columns wide), test R in 0..78 with four not-taken branches, store jmin 0 / jmax R and go straight to jmax_done; the rare left-of-view case (6% of calls) recomputes left - x and re-enters left_of_view with jmax already set (jmin_done is just BRA jmax_done). Alternative to the other candidate (same lines).
candidates.equivalence: R = right - x (16-bit exact). Original: chain C = (R >= 0); R high byte zero => jmax = R low else 255; D = left - x >= 0 => left_of_view (jmin = D low if D high 0 else 255) else jmin 0. Invariant right = left + 79 gives D = R - 79. New: BCC <=> R < 0 -> falls out of the window to the same SEC (SKY_MODE) / RTS as before (dm_jmin/dm_jmax are not read after that exit: sky_put_on branches to fall on C, draw_mover returns). BNE with C = 1: R >= 256, so D >= 0 and the original stores jmax 255 and calls left_of_view; new stores 255 (LDY #&FF / STY), recomputes D with the original chain so C = 1 and Z = (D high is 0) on entry to left_of_view exactly as before, BRA left_of_view, which sets dm_jmin and returns via BRA jmin_done -> BRA jmax_done. H = 0 and Y >= 79: R = 79..255, D >= 0, jmax = R low = Y (high byte zero so no clamp), same recompute path. H = 0 and Y < 79: R = 0..78, D < 0: original takes the fall-through (jmin 0), jmax = R low (high zero so not_right_of_view does not clamp); new STZ dm_jmin / STY dm_jmax / BRA jmax_done. A is dead at jmax_done (LDA dm_typecol), Y is reloaded there, X = slot kept, flags dead. Hot path 46 -> 35 cycles to jmax_done (the old count includes not_right_of_view's taken BEQ jmax_done); rare path about 6 cycles more.
candidates.relies_on: viewport_right = viewport_left + 79 (16 bit) whenever draw_mover/dm_setup run: game.6502 start sets left &00B0 / right &00FF, scroll_screen_left/right inc/dec both with borrow/carry into the high bytes, prebuild.6502 shifts both low bytes by last_dir and restores them inside one routine (never inside a render pass), no other writer (grepped viewport_left/right_*, zero-page &B2 &B3 &BA &BB, respawn rewinds via the normal scroll). Y is dead at every exit (the draw_mover caller at render.6502 1383 then LDY dm_index; sky.6502's dm_setup caller reloads before use; the code after jmax_done sets Y). jmin_done is only entered by left_of_view's BRA. Window grows 15 bytes: bank 4 code and tables after draw_mover slide up 15, so page crossings move: from the listing (bench build, &9A44 = draw_mover.dm_setup) and pcprof's branch counts the taken-branch page crossings that change are BEQ in_hazel (&9CFC, 1.9/pass, stops crossing), BEQ no_part (&9DD0, 3.0/pass, would start crossing), BEQ gathered (&9EFD, 1.8/pass) and BNE gather (&9F39, 1.9/pass) (stop crossing): net about -3 cycles/pass of crossings by that estimate. Indexed table reads that slide across pages (wa_rows_guess &A0F5 at 20/pass, straight_sprite_lo/hi, sprite_column_count, ck_*) are NOT counted; the gate decides. not_right_of_view becomes unreferenced (6 dead bytes, outside the window).

candidates.old:
LDA viewport_left_low
    SEC
    SBC movers_x_low,X
    LDA viewport_left_high          \ (the low byte only for its borrow: left_of_view redoes it)
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS left_of_view                \ viewport_left >= x
    STZ dm_jmin                     \ 65C02 opcode
.jmin_done
    LDA viewport_right_low
    SEC
    SBC movers_x_low,X
    STA dm_jmax
    LDA viewport_right_high
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS not_right_of_view
candidates.new:
LDA viewport_left_low
    SEC
    SBC movers_x_low,X
    TAY                             \ grind: Y = left - x's low byte (A is spent on the high one)
    LDA viewport_left_high
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCS left_of_view                \ viewport_left >= x
    STZ dm_jmin                     \ 65C02 opcode; C = 0, A = the high byte of left - x (negative)
    INC A                           \ right = left + 79 always (the start sets &00B0/&00FF, every scroll
    BNE g4_far                      \ moves both), so right - x = (left - x) + 79: needs the high byte &FF
    TYA
    ADC #79                         \ C = 0: the low byte + 79 carries out iff right >= x
    BCC g4_far                      \ the mover starts right of the viewport
.g4_store
    STA dm_jmax                     \ right - x is 0..78: its low byte
    BRA jmax_done                   \ 65C02 opcode
.jmin_done
    CLC                             \ left_of_view's return, A = jmin: left >= x, so right - x = jmin + 79,
    ADC #79                         \ or past 255 (jmin &FF if the high byte of left - x was not 0)
    BCC g4_store
    LDA #&FF
    BRA g4_store                    \ 65C02 opcode
.g4_far
candidates.summary: D-first clip kept (jmin 0 when left < x) but jmax derived from it instead of a second 16-bit subtraction: right - x = (left - x) + 79, so the visible case needs only INC A / BNE / TYA / ADC #79 / BCC; the rare left-of-view case computes jmax = min(jmin + 79, 255) from A. Smaller (+7 bytes) than the other candidate and cheaper on the rare path, but 4 cycles slower on the hot one. Alternative to the other candidate (same lines).
candidates.equivalence: D = left - x exact 16-bit; the chain leaves A = D high byte (low byte kept in Y), C = 1 iff D >= 0. Invariant right = left + 79 gives right - x = D + 79. D < 0 (BCS not taken, C = 0): jmin 0 as before (STZ); right - x >= 0 iff D >= -79 iff the high byte is &FF (INC A gives Z) and the low byte + 79 carries (TYA / ADC #79, C = 0 still: INC, BNE, TYA leave C); then right - x is 0..78, its high byte is zero, and the original stores the low byte as jmax (= low + 79 mod 256 = A) and reaches jmax_done through BEQ; otherwise the original takes the RTS exit and so does this (BNE/BCC to the code after the window: SEC in SKY_MODE, RTS). D >= 0: left_of_view as before computes jmin; at its BRA jmin_done A = jmin (STA dm_jmin leaves A). right - x = D + 79 >= 0 always; original jmax = low byte of D + 79 if D + 79 < 256 else 255. D + 79 < 256 iff D high = 0 and D low + 79 < 256; jmin = D low then; if D high is not 0 jmin = &FF and &FF + 79 carries. So jmax = jmin + 79 without carry else 255, which is what CLC / ADC #79 / BCC / LDA #&FF yields; then BRA jmax_done, skipping not_right_of_view whose BEQ only chose between those. Y clobbered by TAY: dead at all exits; X kept. Hot path 46 -> 39 cycles to jmax_done; rare path about 12 cycles less.
